procedure PhysioSessions {
  about "Count sessions marked as done and no-show"
  policy PhysioPolicy
  sheet Sessions "Sessions" { patient: Text, mobile: Phone, session_at: DateTime, therapist: Text, status: Text, injury: Text private }
  trigger when Friday 5:30pm

  let all = fetch Sessions
  let done = filter all where status == "done" and days_between(session_at, today()) <= 7
  let no_show = filter all where status == "no-show" and days_between(session_at, today()) <= 7
  let n_done = summarize count of done
  let n_no_show = summarize count of no_show
  let total_done = n_done + n_no_show
  let total_no_show = n_no_show
  let result = "Number of sessions marked as done: " & total_done & ", Number of sessions marked as no-show: " & total_no_show
  let m = draft sms to "Hi {patient default 'there'}, your sessions have been marked as done and no-show. Total done: " & result
  let ok = request approval of m from owner timeout 6 hours else stop "message not approved"
  send ok
}

procedure VetOverdueNotifications {
  about "Notify pet owners about overdue pets"
  policy VetPolicy
  sheet Pets "Pets" { owner: Text, phone: Phone, vaccine_due: Date, status: Text, balance: Money, medical_notes: Text private }
  trigger when requested(days: Number)

  let all = fetch Pets
  let overdue = filter all where days_between(vaccine_due, today()) <= 2 days and status == "overdue"
  let n = summarize count of overdue
  append Pets { owner: today(), phone: vaccine_due, status: "overdue", balance: n }
  let msgs = draft each r in overdue up to 50 sms to r.phone: "Hi {r.owner default 'there'}, your pet {r.name} is overdue. Please contact me on {time_of(r.vaccine_due)}."
  let ok = request batch approval of msgs from owner timeout 1 day else stop "batch not approved"
  send ok
}
